digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1 web-search capability routing
propositions: Bedrock-routed Claude models lost web-search access for blocking criterion T1 because the provider-name prefix gate 'resolved.startswith("anthropic")' fails when resolved is 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8' instead of 'anthropic:...'

The capability decision incorrectly relies on provider-name prefix matching rather than registry membership, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule that provider qualification must not depend on name shape
Web-search attachment is silent—no warning is logged and provider_provenance.capabilities does not record whether web access was attached, making the withdrawal invisible in signed verdicts
T1 is a blocking criterion that now executes without its declared grounding tool, weakening evidence for decisions that can block a plan from codebase/model knowledge alone instead of current sources

Web access must be required for T1 on every provider rebar routes to it, not optional or provider-conditional; the current provider-side-only design must be revisited to ensure a fallback mechanism exists where native server-side tools are unavailable
